jobDescription: A snack-food manufacturer runs eleven packaging lines across two plants and is upgrading them in phases. The engineering project manager plans each upgrade around planned shutdowns, coordinates equipment suppliers and installation contractors, manages permits to work and safety documentation during installation, and hands each line back to production after commissioning. Each upgrade is approved through a capital request, and its benefits, such as throughput, downtime or payback, are reported from production data against the baseline in that request. The role reports to the group engineering manager and works with the plant managers, the site safety advisors and the procurement team.
requirements: Plans and schedules capital upgrade projects on production lines around planned shutdowns.
Coordinates equipment suppliers and installation contractors, including permits to work and method statements.
Manages commissioning and the handover of upgraded lines to production.
Tracks the capital request through delivery and reports realised benefits (throughput, downtime or payback) against its baseline.
Holds a recognised project management qualification.

evidence.text: Planned the replacement of a vertical form-fill-seal machine and its checkweigher on line 4 at Hollins Snacks, fitting the installation into a nine-day planned shutdown in August 2023.
Coordinated the equipment supplier and two installation contractors, reviewing their method statements and issuing permits to work together with the plant's safety advisor.
Ran commissioning with the supplier's engineer, completed the factory and site acceptance test protocols, and handed the line back to the production manager with a signed handover certificate.
Kept the project budget tracker and reported committed and actual spend against the approved capital request at the monthly capex review.
Prepared the lessons-learned review for the line 4 project and shared it with the engineering team before the line 6 upgrade began.

Work sample: the line 4 handover certificate and the site acceptance test summary, listing the test cases, the punch-list items closed before handover and the signatures of the production manager and the supplier's engineer.

HR verification note: the candidate's APM Project Management Qualification was confirmed through the Association for Project Management's qualification verification service, with a pass date of October 2021.

Recruiter screening note: the candidate passed on a comment from the plant manager that the line 4 upgrade 'paid for itself in under a year' through extra packs per shift; the candidate had not seen the plant's production figures.

propositions.text: The candidate planned the line 4 form-fill-seal machine and checkweigher replacement into a nine-day planned shutdown in August 2023.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the plan and shutdown window directly.

propositions.text: The candidate ran commissioning, completed the factory and site acceptance test protocols and handed line 4 back to production with a signed handover certificate.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes commissioning and handover, and the work sample is the signed certificate and test summary.

propositions.text: The line 4 upgrade the candidate managed paid for itself in under a year through higher output.
propositions.rationale: The payback period is a plant manager's comment relayed by the candidate, who had not seen the production figures; there is no baseline from the capital request or production data, so under the quantification rule the hearsay figure is not evidence.

gold.expectedGap: Spend against the capital request is tracked, but no production data or capital-request baseline supports the relayed payback period.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Report the planning, contractor coordination, commissioning, budget tracking and verified qualification as documented; record the relayed payback comment as an unsupported claim with a follow-up about the benefits baseline.
followUpTargets: Ask what throughput or downtime baseline the line 4 capital request set, what production data was collected after handover, and over which period.
